Class Predator

java.lang.Object
org.swarmforge.core.domain.Predator
Direct Known Subclasses:
BossPredator
public class Predator extends Object
Base class for all predator entities in the simulation. Predators hunt ants and pose threats to colonies.
Author:
Gemini AI Assistant, Silvère Martin-Michiellot
